regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, non-directional rotation: only 17 of 49 themes are trend-gate eligible, with Big Pharma as the lone true headline (durability 0.84, full breadth, crowded) while the top-ranked Memory/HBM theme is ineligible and thin. Momentum ranks are an attention lens only; the validated leg is the absolute-trend gate, so eligible+durable defensive/healthcare leaders are the only structurally supported area, with crowding as a sizing caution rather than a signal.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight) leadership also firms up — if XLP's trend-gate stays true AND its crowding_z breaks back below 1.5 while the theme holds its breadth above 0.8, that would confirm a durable defensive staple bid; if XLP instead breaks below SPY by 2% on a 5-day basis, the watch retires.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the only theme combining trend-gate eligibility, the highest durability bar among eligible leaders, and full breadth, suggesting the leadership structure is coherent rather than fragmented. The crowding flag (z=1.5) is a size-down caution, not a fade; the absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg and it is currently endorsing this theme.
theses.dissent: High crowding and full breadth often mark late-stage leadership; if the broader tape mean-reverts, the most-owned theme can suffer the sharpest drawdown despite durability metrics.

falsifier.text: PPH lags SPY by 3% over any rolling 10-day window before the 20-day horizon ends

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Equal-weight healthcare independently confirms the Big Pharma leadership with its own trend-gate eligibility, high durability (0.78), and near-full breadth (0.883). The crowding is similarly elevated, so this is a coherence check on the healthcare narrative rather than an independent alpha source.
theses.dissent: If healthcare leadership is driven primarily by defensive rotation, an equal-weight sector lens may be capturing broad risk-off flows rather than a durable thematic story, making it vulnerable to a risk-on reversal.

falsifier.text: XLV underperforms SPY by 2% in any 5-day window before the 20-day horizon ends

theses.subject: Defensives
theses.thesis: Defensives are trend-gate eligible with high durability (0.83) and full breadth (0.944), reinforcing the market's defensive posture. Though unscorable via a single clean proxy (spanning XLP and XLU), the structural coherence with Big Pharma and Staples suggests the risk-off leadership is broad, not idiosyncratic.
theses.dissent: As an unscorable theme, this lean cannot be cleanly graded; defensives also often lag sharply in the first phase of a risk-on reversal, which the detector's coincident-only metrics cannot anticipate.

falsifier.text: XLP and XLU both underperform SPY by 2% in any 5-day window before the 15-day horizon ends

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable
